verdict.rationale: Fireworks is an OpenAI-compatible REST API accessed via api.fireworks.ai with no GUI dependency, plus a CLI (firectl) for deployment automation, batch inference for async bulk processing, and function-calling/tool-use for agentic workflows — all naturally usable in CI/headless pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples (GitHub Actions, cron jobs), an official SDK/CLI doc page dedicated to automation, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI usage.
